turns.patient_response: Lately I’ve been feeling really overwhelmed and not handling stress the way I usually do. I feel like my reactions to things have gotten out of control, and it’s starting to affect my day-to-day life, so I wanted to get some help figuring out what’s going on.

symptom_reasoning.S081: The patient reports feeling increasingly overwhelmed, not handling stress as usual, and experiencing out-of-control reactions that are affecting daily life, consistent with a maladaptive response to stress.
